Fable: How Playground Games is Building Albion for a New Generation | Official XBOX Podcast
On this episode of the Official XBOX Podcast, we're still in Cologne, Germany, and this time, we're sitting down with Playground Games to discuss one of our most anticipated games: Fable. We're getting more details on the gameplay the team shared at Gamescom while diving into the combat, story, and world that players got to experience at the convention.

The Last Caretaker - XBOX Announcement Trailer
The Last Caretaker comes to XBOX with Game Pass Day One in Spring 2027, alongside 1.0 on PC. More than 400,000 copies sold. Around 50 hours average playtime. Seven updates shipped.

Next: Update 6.0 to PC in early October.
Then the road continues toward Spring 2027.
And when we reach 1.0: We do not stop.
